notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — two P0 bugs: (1) MTA-STS policy endpoint always 404 in production due to Host header mismatch; (2) REQUIRETLS from inbound MAIL FROM silently dropped and not propagated to relay. Both would be caught immediately in production smoke tests.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — ownership patterns are mostly correct, error handling uses typed enums (#[non_exhaustive] present), iterator usage clean, no unsafe. Main issues: String-wrapping error variants lose structure; fetch_url ownership; dead enum variants.
Confidence: 80% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: whether REQUIRETLS inbound is truly absent from SessionState or handled elsewhere (session.rs is large). Uncertainty driven by: not reading the full DATA handler path in session.rs. Would raise confidence if: read remainder of session.rs DATA path.
Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance of missed issue. Least confident: whether the Mutex pattern causes any real-world issues given the async executor used.
title: Review: MTA-STS, REQUIRETLS, STARTTLS downgrade protection
